security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline code, documentation links, and recommendations to capture real screenshots. The command examples perform local batch changes and a network request, while the reference guide recommends uploading image assets to external providers without privacy safeguards.

remediation.issue: The optimization workflow includes batch commands and a curl request that can modify local files or contact a user-selected host.
remediation.suggestion: Require confirmation before execution, scope batch commands to explicit files, and validate remote URLs before fetching them.

remediation.issue: The prompting guide recommends uploading product screenshots, brand assets, and reference images to external AI providers.
remediation.suggestion: Require user approval and advise removing secrets, personal data, customer data, and confidential interface details before upload.

content.value_statement: Marketing teams need consistent images that fit each channel and load efficiently. This skill guides image planning, prompting, production, and web optimization.
actual_capabilities: Recommends image approaches and tools based on format, brand requirements, text needs, and production volume.
Creates structured prompts with subject, setting, style, lighting, composition, and technical specifications.
Provides current dimensions and workflows for blog heroes, social graphics, profile banners, and listing images.
Guides real product screenshot capture and annotation instead of generating inaccurate interfaces.
Explains image formats, compression, responsive delivery, metadata, and dynamic OG image workflows.
limitations: The skill provides guidance and examples but includes no image generator, API client, or design application.
External image services may require accounts, API keys, subscriptions, and separate privacy review.
Provider features, prices, model names, and platform dimensions can change after publication.
Generated visuals still require human review for brand accuracy, text quality, licensing, and sensitive information.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Blog Hero

prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt [campaign concept] for [platforms]. List dimensions, crop guidance, safe text placement, and a consistent production workflow using [brand assets].

prompt_templates.title: Design a Product Mockup
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a product mockup using real screenshots from [product]. Specify capture resolution, device framing, annotations, export sizes, and privacy checks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced product presentation with real interface assets

prompt_templates.title: Automate OG Images
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a scalable OG image workflow for [site stack]. Compare template options, define dynamic fields, metadata requirements, fallbacks, and performance checks.

output_examples.input: Create a hero image plan for an article about email deliverability.
output_examples.output: Concept: a clear message path through visual noise. Use a 1200x630 composition with generous title space, then export WebP below 200KB.

output_examples.input: Prepare one launch graphic for LinkedIn, Instagram, and Twitter/X.
output: Start with the largest approved composition and preserve a centered safe area.
Export 1200x627 for LinkedIn, 1080x1080 for Instagram, and 1200x675 for Twitter/X.
Review every crop at its actual display size before publication.

output_examples.input: Generate an image of our application dashboard.
output_examples.output: Use a real dashboard screenshot at double resolution. Frame it in a browser mockup, remove sensitive data, and add concise feature callouts.

best_practices: Confirm the placement, dimensions, brand assets, visual style, and production volume before choosing a tool.
Use real screenshots for product interfaces and remove confidential or personal information before sharing assets externally.
Export responsive formats, compress final files, set explicit dimensions, and review accessibility text.
anti_patterns: Do not generate fictional product interfaces when customers need to see the real product.
Do not upload confidential screenshots, customer data, or unreleased brand assets without approval and redaction.
Do not publish oversized images or reuse one crop across platforms without checking each placement.

faq.question: Does this skill generate images directly?
faq.answer: No. It plans workflows and prompts for external image models, design tools, screenshot tools, and optimization utilities.

faq.question: Which image model should I choose?
faq.answer: Choose based on text accuracy, editing needs, reference support, visual style, budget, and provider availability.

faq.question: Can it create product screenshots?
faq.answer: It recommends capturing the real interface because generated screens can misrepresent product behavior and details.

faq.question: What format should I use on websites?
faq.answer: WebP is the general default. Consider AVIF for stronger compression and provide suitable fallbacks where required.

faq.question: How does it support brand consistency?
faq.answer: It recommends approved templates, brand assets, reference images, stable prompt structures, and human review.

faq.question: Are external uploads safe?
faq.answer: Review provider terms first. Remove secrets, personal data, customer information, and confidential interface details before any upload.
